sloka: एवं ब्रुवाणामरजां दण्डः कामवशं गतः ।प्रत्युवाच मदोन्मत्तः शिरस्याधाय चाञ्जलिम् ।। ७.८०.१३ ॥
transliteration: evaṁ bruvāṇāmarajāṁ daṇḍaḥ kāmavaśaṁ gataḥ ।pratyuvāca madonmattaḥ śirasyādhāya cāñjalim ।। 7.80.13 ॥

translations.english: Having thus gone under the sway of desire, Danda, intoxicated with passion, replied to Araja, placing his folded hands on his head.
